body.statement: Let independent centered random vectors in a fixed finite dimension have identity summed covariance. The supremum, over convex Borel sets, of the absolute difference between the distribution of their sum and the standard Gaussian distribution is at most \(400\) times the fourth root of the dimension times the sum of their third Euclidean absolute moments.

attestation.note: Specialized from Bentkus's convex-set multivariate Berry--Esseen theorem; stable DOI supplied in place of a verbatim transcription.
